motivation: V1 augmentation, S2 offline and S2 interleaved all reached ceiling on unseen pairs when transformed training covered every verb. Test transfer to a verb absent from transformed training.
primary_development_measure: joint correct actor and patient across five forms for withheld pairs using followed, absent from transformed training
technical_screen: Wake canonical accuracy on followed >= 0.90 and wake joint L2 event accuracy <= 0.80.
stop_rule: If augmentation, offline and interleaved tie at ceiling or floor, stop this synthetic schedule direction; do not search confirmation graphs for a positive effect.
interpretation: One-seed difficulty diagnostic, not natural-language evidence or a publishable effect.
